decisions.reason: As a foundational architecture with low keeping costs and multiple future uses, its option value remains high and uncertainty has not revealed a need to abandon it.
After several years, this peripheral email-to-app robot has likely shown limited value relative to its higher keeping costs, so the option is no longer worth maintaining.
The hardware token's inventory and support costs continue to weigh on the option, and software-based alternatives have likely reduced its strategic value.
Payment network security compliance remains a valuable, low-cost option tied to strong regulatory demand and the firm's existing suite.
